log.label: No precautions. That's the point.
log.line:
Door dogged. Skud fucks Uasyyl slow, then all the way, cock in her cunt, bunk frame knocking the wall. They say it: they want a child on this hull. Outside, a watch changes. Inside, nobody stands it. Uasyyl: "Say it again: you want a child on this hull." Not this cycle.
Uasyyl: "If the mess asks, we were reviewing seals. Sleep if you can."

log.label: Back to the watch
log.line: Uasyyl: "I liked who I was just then. Sleep if you can."

log.label: Good work out there

log.label: Stay on after this contract?
log.line: Uasyyl: "Yes. I think yes."

log.label: Shake on it
log.line: Uasyyl: "Done. You've got me. …and what do I get? Not money. Say something true."

log.label: My back, every time
log.line: Uasyyl: "That'll do. That'll more than do."

log.label: Tell me about yourself
log.line: Uasyyl: "Sirrah, from a tether town built out of a dead hauler. She/her, if you're asking. I'm drawn to women. I signed on for the cut. No shame in it. I'm particular. That's not a puzzle for the mess. Next question."
